growth_signal.value: Reached about 100 active workspaces before launching publicly.

entry.idea: When a software product changes, its documentation, website text and support articles often fall out of date, so Thally watches a company's code and content repositories and works out exactly which pages need updating.
entry.lesson: If you personally suffered through a slow, manual task at several jobs, the shortcut you build for yourself can become the product.
entry.name: Thally

growth.basis: number: about 100 active workspaces at launch
growth.reason: Reaching about 100 workspaces before public launch is a real but modest early signal, with no growth rate over time yet.

market.reason: Every software company needs its documentation and support content to stay accurate, but this is one function within a company, not a market everyone touches.

tech.reason: Tracing a product change across connected docs, websites and support content and writing the fix is a clever approach, but other AI documentation tools are chasing the same idea.

sources.title: Nigeria's Thally launches to provide the product knowledge layer for software teams - Disrupt Africa
Thally Launches AI Documentation Startup: TechMoran
Thally launches AI documentation platform - Gmap Track

entry.twist: Instead of just flagging outdated pages, Thally opens a pull request with the fix already written and the evidence behind it, so a human only has to check and approve it, and it also hosts the documentation itself, readable by people or by AI tools.
entry.who_pays: Software companies, through their product and developer-experience teams, that need their documentation, websites and support content to stay correct.
entry.why_now: Companies are shipping product changes faster than ever, so keeping documentation and support content accurate by hand can no longer keep pace.
